{{Short description|American academic (1950–2023)}}
[[File:Ledolter-johannes.jpg|thumb|Johannes Ledolter]]
'''Johannes Ledolter''' (August 26, 1950 – November 5, 2023)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Obituary information for Johannes Ledolter |url=https://www.lensingfuneral.com/obituaries/Johannes-Ledolter?obId=29856775 |access-date=2023-11-20 |website=www.lensingfuneral.com |archive-date=2023-11-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231121223558/https://www.lensingfuneral.com/obituaries/Johannes-Ledolter?obId=29856775 |url-status=live }}</ref> was an American applied [[statistician]]. He was a chaired Professor of [[Business analytics|Business Analytics]] and Statistics/Actuarial Science at the [[University of Iowa]] as well as an emeritus Professor at the [[Vienna University of Economics and Business]] in Austria, and served as an associate investigator for the [[Iowa City, Iowa|Iowa City]] VA Health Care System.

Ledolter was initially brought to the United States by the Fulbright Scholarship. He authored 10 books and more than 150 journal articles and chapters.

== Education ==
Ledolter earned a [[Master of Science|M.S.]] in statistics from the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison|University of Wisconsin-Madison]] in 1972<ref name="auto">{{Cite web |title=Professor Johannes Ledolter, Henry B. Tippie College of Business, The University of Iowa |url=https://www.biz.uiowa.edu/faculty/jledolter/ |access-date=2023-11-20 |website=www.biz.uiowa.edu |archive-date=2023-11-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231120214510/https://www.biz.uiowa.edu/faculty/jledolter/ |url-status=live }}</ref> and in Social and Economic Statistics from the [[University of Vienna]] in 1974.<ref name="auto" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Johannes Ledolter Obituary (2023) - Iowa City, IA - The Gazette |url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/thegazette/name/johannes-ledolter-obituary?id=53568622 |access-date=2023-11-20 |website=Legacy.com |archive-date=2023-11-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231121223557/https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/thegazette/name/johannes-ledolter-obituary?id=53568622 |url-status=live }}</ref> In 1975, he earned a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in statistics from the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison|University of Wisconsin-Madison]].

== Teaching and consulting ==
Ledolter taught beginning and advanced courses on statistical methods at the University of Iowa, Vienna University of Economics and Business, [[Institute for Advanced Studies (Vienna)|Institute for Advanced Studies]], [[Stanford University]], [[University of Chicago Booth School of Business]], [[Yale University]], and [[Princeton University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Johannes Ledolter {{!}} Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science - The University of Iowa |url=https://stat.uiowa.edu/people/johannes-ledolter |access-date=2023-11-20 |website=stat.uiowa.edu |archive-date=2023-11-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231120204515/https://stat.uiowa.edu/people/johannes-ledolter |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="auto" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Ledolter, Johannes (1970) |url=https://shs.univie.ac.at/alumni/alumni-postings/1970-1979/ledolter-johannes-1970/ |access-date=2023-11-20 |website=shs.univie.ac.at |language=en |archive-date=2023-11-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231121223609/https://shs.univie.ac.at/alumni/alumni-postings/1970-1979/ledolter-johannes-1970/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

He had consulted with the [[California|state of California]], [[Ford Motor Company]], [[Procter & Gamble]], [[Celanese]], [[American Express]], [[Bemis Company]], and the [[A1 Telekom Austria Group]].<ref name="auto" />

== Selected publications ==

* Ledolter, J. and Swersey, A.J.: ''Testing 1 – 2 – 3: Experimental Design with Applications in Marketing and Service Operations'',<ref>{{Cite web |last=Noble |first=Barnes & |title=Analyzing Textual Information: From Words to Meanings through Numbers{{!}}eBook |url=https://www.barnesandnoble.com/w/analyzing-textual-information-johannes-ledolter/1138643673 |access-date=2023-11-20 |website=Barnes & Noble |language=en |archive-date=2023-11-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231120212108/https://www.barnesandnoble.com/w/analyzing-textual-information-johannes-ledolter/1138643673 |url-status=live }}</ref> Stanford University Press, 2007
* Ledolter, J. and VanderVelde, L.S.: ''Analyzing Textual Information: From Words to Meanings through Numbers'', SAGE Publishing (Quantitative Applications in the Social Sciences), 2021.<ref name="auto" />
